findings.current: By now, it was no secret to them alone that an entire hundred-man scouting party from the Great Snow Mountain had been found nearby an hour earlier, their bodies cold.
findings.defect: The scouts were encountered, not found dead, and one shichen is approximately two hours, not one.
findings.rationale: 맞닥트린 describes the encounter; 한 시진 전 places it approximately two hours earlier.
findings.replacement: By now, they weren’t the only ones who knew that the hundred scouts from the Great Snow Mountain they had encountered nearby two hours earlier were dead.
findings.source: 한 시진 전, 인근에서 맞닥트린 대설산의 척후조 일백이 싸늘한 주검이 되었다는 것은 이제 그들만이 아는 비밀이 아니었다.

findings.current: They had left two hours earlier to check on the enemy’s movements. Now they’d returned as one.
findings.defect: Two shichen becomes two hours instead of approximately four.
findings.rationale: 두 시진 is approximately four hours.
findings.replacement: They had left four hours earlier to check on the enemy’s movements. Now they’d returned as one.
findings.source: 두 시진 전, 적들의 동태를 파악하기 위해 떠났다는 그들은 한 몸이 되어 돌아왔다.

findings.current: My lips trembled, unable to finish the word.
findings.defect: The draft identifies the trembling lips as Taekyung’s, though the source leaves the speaker unidentified.
findings.rationale: Nothing in this passage establishes that Taekyung said “This…”.
findings.replacement: The speaker’s lips trembled, unable to finish the thought.
findings.source: 미처 말을 잇지 못한 채 파르르 떨리는 입술.

findings.current: *Pathetic fools. Was I really supposed to take over the world with the likes of them?*
findings.defect: “I” assigns the attempted conquest to the Blood-Sword Demon Lord; the source does not specify that subject, and the following lines extend his scorn to the Cult Leader.
findings.rationale: The Korean leaves the actor implicit rather than making the Demon Lord’s own plan the object of ridicule.
findings.replacement: *Pathetic fools. Had they really tried to conquer the world with the likes of these men?*
findings.source: ‘한심한 것들 같으니. 고작 이런 놈들로 천하를 도모하려 했단 말인가.’

findings.current: the enemies of the Great Snow Mountain, drawing nearer even now, would soon serve the Lord of Heaven alongside him.
findings.defect: “Enemies of the Great Snow Mountain” can mean enemies opposing the mountain; he means his opponents at the mountain.
findings.rationale: 저 대설산의 적들 refers to the forces he expects to confront there.
findings.replacement: his enemies at the Great Snow Mountain, drawing nearer even now, would soon serve the Lord of Heaven alongside him.
findings.source: 저 대설산의 적들도, 머지않아 자신과 함께 천주를 섬기게 되리라고

findings.current: He’d struck without hesitation over a single word that displeased him.
findings.defect: “Struck” loses that he launched a potentially lethal attack over the remark.
findings.rationale: 살수를 내뻗고 conveys a killing move, not merely a blow.
findings.replacement: He’d lashed out with a killing blow without hesitation over a single word that displeased him.
findings.source: 심기를 거스르는 말 한마디에 망설임 없이 살수(殺手)를 내뻗고

findings.current: The three fiends of Tianshan, who had once drenched the Central Plains in blood beneath the Demonic Cult’s banner, could do nothing but bow down before him.
findings.defect: “Bow down” weakens their frantic, full prostration.
findings.rationale: 앞다투어 adds their haste to outdo one another, and 부복 means prostrating themselves.
findings.replacement: The three fiends of Tianshan, who had once drenched the Central Plains in blood beneath the Demonic Cult’s banner, scrambled to prostrate themselves before him.
findings.source: 한때 마교의 깃발 아래서 중원을 피로 물들였던 천산의 세 악귀는 앞다투어 부복할 수밖에 없었다.

findings.current: “The Fire King alone will never be able to stop us.”
findings.defect: “Alone” suggests that allies might make the difference; the speaker dismisses the Fire King himself.
findings.rationale: 고작 화왕 따위로는 is contemptuous dismissal, not a qualification about fighting alone.
findings.replacement: “Someone like the Fire King could never stop us.”
findings.source: 고작 화왕 따위로는, 결코 우리를 막을 수는 없어.

findings.current: The middle-aged man looked over the three elders in turn, then clicked his tongue.
findings.defect: He smacks his lips and mutters; he does not click his tongue here.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다시며 and 중얼거렸다 specify both actions.
findings.replacement: The middle-aged man looked over the three elders in turn, smacked his lips, and muttered.
findings.source: 세 명의 노인을 차례대로 훑어본 중년인이 입맛을 다시며 중얼거렸다.

findings.defect: The draft introduces a mistaken transliteration for the telescope already identified in the preceding paragraph.
findings.rationale: 십리경 refers to that same object; the invented romanization adds confusion without conveying a distinction.
findings.replacement: snatched the telescope from his hand

summary: The draft changes two time intervals, assigns an unidentified reaction to Taekyung, and blurs several consequential actions and references.
